cohort: The study included 208 women with histological diagnosis of EOC (cases) and 224 age-matched women in a control group who presented for a well-woman examination.
finding: The study found significant associations between various peritoneal insults (diverticulosis, hysterectomy, endometriosis, exploratory laparotomy, bilateral tubal ligation) and the likelihood of developing specific epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) subtypes, while diabetes mellitus and no prior surgical history decreased the likelihood of all EOC.
